backupRestore.authNote: The graph dump does not include system users/roles; the fresh server initializes its own demo credentials.

withoutIndex.statement: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = $name RETURN p {.*} AS person

withIndex.statement: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = $name RETURN p {.*} AS person

containsWithIndex.statement: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE toLower(p.name) CONTAINS toLower($name) RETURN count(p) AS total

descendants.statement: MATCH (:Person {id:$root})-[:PARENT_OF*1..]->(p:Person) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS total

profile.timingNote: Client HTTP wall time includes PROFILE and serialization overhead; not a production latency benchmark.
